column7: SAML ACS left a JIT-provisioned user and partially reconciled roles on a mintSession failure. Andrei's #2839 decision classifies JIT provisioning and the group/role reconcile as class C (independent, idempotent, convergent: docs/atomicity-exempt.tsv JIT row), sound only together with condition 1: no session is minted over a reconcile that did not fully apply (#2903 SAML, #2907 OIDC). This test drives the failed-revocation faults through the SAML ACS and OIDC callback ops and requires the login to be refused with no session; the class-C oracle rule and its calibration are TestSSOClassCRule_*. Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
